statement: For every 0<a<b, there is a smooth non-Brownian chordal Loewner driver on every interval [0,T] with T<ab/4 for which the single Cardy observable C((g_t(a)-W_t)/(g_t(b)-W_t)) is an exact constant martingale.
assumptions: one pair of real boundary marks a<b
source: owner-own-work: w410 ATTEMPT.md, section 'New special-case counterexample'
proof_or_counterexample: Set u=a/b, Y=sqrt(b^2-4t/u), X=uY, W=(1+u)(b-Y). Then g(a)=W+X and g(b)=W+Y solve the real Loewner ODE, X/Y=u, while W'>0 and <W>=0.
independent_reviewer: w413 requested by task brief; pending
remaining_gap: Only rules out identification from one Cardy martingale. Does not establish either martingale approximation for actual square-lattice percolation.

statement: The standard FK q=1 parafermionic spin in the 2026-09-07 C0017-A001 attempt is 1/3, not the row's 2/3.
assumptions: Use the spin convention in Definition 3 of arXiv:1208.3787
source: https://arxiv.org/pdf/1208.3787, Definition 3, PDF page 7 (P6); equation: sin(sigma*pi/2)=sqrt(q)/2. C0017-A001 at attempts.jsonl:17 says 'spin sigma = 2/3'.
proof_or_counterexample: At q=1, sin(sigma*pi/2)=1/2 and sigma in [0,1] imply sigma=1/3. Zhou arXiv:2409.03235v6 defines its observable with exp(iW/3), consistent with this convention.
